description: Every source of compatibility data edgefit ships, pinned. Results only change when this data changes.

sources.note: The Bun, Deno and workerd dumps were regenerated on 2026-10-23, at the versions of this entry. They were made with the provider's own scripts at this commit, on Linux without a terminal, through this repository's Dump data workflow. The provider's repository has no newer data. Deno runs with --allow-sys, which 2.9 needs. The Node baseline is unchanged.
The exports of unenv's Node polyfills that are constant values, read with scripts/unenv/generate.mjs from the release wrangler pins.
The answer of the production witness, read on 2026-10-03 after Witness run 37075288327. Netlify hides Deno.version.deno; navigator.userAgent and process.versions.deno report 2.3.1.

API names and hashes read from Vercel's documentation, and member lists from next and @vercel/node (MIT); no text is copied. AsyncLocalStorage in witnessGlobals comes from the production witness answer, read on 2026-10-03 after Witness run 37078244260.

API names and hashes read from Vercel's documentation; no text is copied. Entries whose source is the production witness answer, read on 2026-10-03 after Witness run 37078244260, link it at a pinned commit.

The global names that lib.dom.d.ts of TypeScript 5.9.3 declares as a var, let, const, function or class and lib.webworker.d.ts does not, without `toString`. The column of a runtime lists the names that the runtime also has. The workerd, Bun and Deno columns come from `typeof globalThis[name]` on the versions that the data pins: workerd 1.20260929.1, Bun 1.4.4 and Deno 2.9.7. Deno Deploy uses the Deno column. The Netlify column is the list of these names in the production witness of 2026-10-03 for a Netlify Edge Function. Deno 2.3.1 has the same names, except `window`. Vercel Edge has no column, so no name is present there. No name is in the middleware names of the Vercel witness or in `@edge-runtime/vm` 5.0.0. The Vercel edge route does not show its own names.
